name: Todoroki Arashi
source:
Star Sign: Taurus
Hobby: Searching for mysterious and unconfirmed animals
Likes: The flavor of Mochimochi Karitto-kun Cheese, Calpis Water

A waiter at 'Prince Pia♥Carrot', he goes to the same high school as the protagonist. 
A pushy person who does things at his own pace. He's rather charismatic.
